L8·N1311unmasked layer

L13·N2405unmasked layer
This neuron fires on tokens that are parts of proper-noun/named-entity strings — especially subword pieces of unusual or non-English names of people, places, and festivals (e.g. "Ken|so", "U|kan|af|un", "Mahots|av", "Kogi State") — and is strongly suppressed on ordinary English function words and verbs in plain narrative prose ("a", "needed", "went", "n't").
